content.description: Iteration 2: shorter headways, much stronger early start and red running, sidewalk-led space seeking, longer box hold.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car 0.74 vs 0.35 s and M5/length 48.6 vs 15.8 m: tau 0.5 and minGap 1.0 (range minimum) with accel 3.5 shorten discharge headway so queues clear faster in each green.
M9a 1.0-1.9 vs 0.57 veh/cycle: small car group that may use the right-turn lane, with the same short headway as car_normal for M1/car.
M1/moto 0.49 vs 0.30 s, M5/moto_density and M4/overshoot_share: tau 0.4, minGap 0.5, accel 6 speed up discharge; arbitrary alignment with minGapLat 0.3 gave M4/lat_moto 7.25 vs 7.19 m in iteration 1.
Behaviour 10 / M6/approach s moto (sim 38-44 vs 35.7 s): speedFactor 0.8 (was 0.7) keeps the s approach time near target without lengthening the l/u queues.
M10a 0-0.1 vs 0.56 sidewalk riders per cycle: share raised from 0.18 to 0.30 so more riders can take the sidewalk; short headway for M1/moto.
M7a/n_waiting 1.4-2.6 vs 5.6 and M7b clear_lag: jmTimegapMinor 1.0 (was 0.8) makes riders accept fewer gaps so more of them wait in the box at the opposing green end.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto 0.017 vs 0.13 and M2/first_delay 0.7 vs 2.8 s, M4/overshoot_share 0 vs 0.62: p 0.15 gave only 0.017, so p is raised to 1 with the full 10 s window; slow creep puts riders past the stop line at green onset.
M2/early/car 0 vs 0.011: p 0.02 gave 0, a slightly higher p with an 8 s window gives rare creeping.
M3/share/moto 0.007 vs 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 0.29 vs 3.9: p0 0.06 was about 10x too low; p0 0.6 (Saval 0.5 front-row motorcycles) with a small k keeps M3/var_to_mean near 1.14.
M3/share/car 0 vs 0.004: p0 0.004 gave no events, 0.012 gives rare car red running without a swarm effect.

M10a 0.1 vs 0.56 and M9a 1.0-1.9 vs 0.57: p_sidewalk 0.5 (custom1, LVL_W/E) moves seekers to the sidewalk, p_right_lane cut to 0.03 reduces right-lane blocking; p_wrong_lane 0 because it is inapplicable (R27); q 8 m fits the shorter queues (M10b/M9c obs 15 m).
M7a/release_time -1.3 to -5.3 vs 2.8 s: iteration-1 lags of 1.0-1.5 s released waiters before the opposing green end; 2.5 s extra hold moves exit time later (M7b clear_lag 5.6 vs 5.5 stays close).
Behaviour 10, M4/lat_moto and M6 approach: slow riders keep the lane centre, unchanged.

reasoning: Iteration 1 showed queues far too long (M5/length 45-49 vs 15.8 m) with discharge headways too slow (M1 0.74/0.49 vs 0.35/0.30 s), so tau, minGap and accel were set to near their limits for cars and motorcycles. Early start (p 1, 10 s) and swarm red running (p0 0.6) were raised about 8-10x because M2/early/moto and M3/share/moto were 8-14x too low. Space seeking now favours the sidewalk (p_sidewalk 0.5, moto_seeker share 0.30) with less right-lane use because M10a was far too low and M9a too high; wrong_lane is 0 as it is inapplicable. The box hold was raised to 2.5 s because M7a/release_time was negative, and jmTimegapMinor to 1.0 for more box waiters.
